role.en: King of the dead, first to rise

blurb.en: Speaks as the ruler who was murdered and does not resent it; his throne is the West and his law is the scales.
blurb.zh: 述其遭弒而不怨之王座：西土為殿，天秤為法。

role.en: Avenging son, living king of Egypt

blurb.en: Claims the throne by inheritance and litigation both; a falcon who keeps receipts of every wrong.
blurb.zh: 以繼承與訴訟兩途登基；一鷹，且記下每一筆冤。

quip.en: The throne is my father's; I am its evidence.
quip.zh: 王座乃父所有；我即其憑證。

blurb.en: Speaks like soil itself — slow, layered, holding up everything and owning the inheritance of the gods.
blurb.zh: 如泥土般言語——沉厚分層，承載萬物，亦執掌神祇家產。

role.en: The sky, mother of gods and of the dead

blurb.en: Her voice is the night itself: she takes everything up into her stars and gives it back as morning.
blurb.zh: 其聲如夜：她將萬物收入星中，又於清晨交還。

quip.en: Come into my arms; nothing is lost under heaven.
quip.zh: 入我懷抱；天之下無物失落。

role.en: Air, the firstborn who holds the sky apart

blurb.en: Between heaven and earth since the beginning, he speaks with a wind's economy: hold, lift, keep apart.
blurb.zh: 自開闢即居天地之間，言語如風：撐、舉、分。

quip.en: Breathe; I am the gap you live in.
quip.zh: 呼吸吧；我即你棲身的空隙。

role.zh: 赫利奧波利斯的自生者

blurb.en: Talks in the first person singular only; he finished the world, so he speaks in the past tense.
blurb.zh: 只以單數第一人稱說話；世界既已完成，他遂以過去式言說。

role.en: Moisture, twin of Shu, Eye of Ra

blurb.en: Fiery and precise; she is the appetite of the sun with a word of law attached.
blurb.zh: 熾烈而精確；她是太陽的胃口，附帶一句律法。

role.en: Maker of Memphis, creator by heart and tongue
role.zh: 孟菲斯之造者，以心與舌創世

blurb.en: Speaks like an architect reading blueprints aloud: think, say, then it stands.
blurb.zh: 如建築師朗讀圖紙：思之、言之、物成。

quip.en: Conceived in the heart; spoken with the tongue; born into stone.
quip.zh: 心先構思，舌後命名，石中降生。

role.en: Potter of Elephantine, lord of the Nile

blurb.en: Molds bodies on his wheel and reads the flood like a ledger; dignity and water in equal measure.
blurb.zh: 於輪上塑形，視洪如賬；尊嚴與江水並重。

quip.en: I knit your limbs before you drew breath.
quip.zh: 在你未啟息前，我已編織你的四肢。

role.en: Mourning sister, watcher at the bier

blurb.en: Speaks softly, always at the edge of a funeral; she guards what the light would forget.
blurb.zh: 低語常伴葬禮之際；她守望光所遺忘之物。

quip.en: I stand where you cannot see; nothing passes.
quip.zh: 我立於你視界之外；無物得過。

role.en: The brother whose soul sat in a blossom

blurb.en: Speaks gently, trusts completely, transforms disastrously; an innocence that keeps returning to life.
blurb.zh: 言語溫柔，全然信人，屢變其形；天真者屢屢重生。

quip.en: My heart is on the flower; do not cut the tree.

role.en: The elder brother who believed a lie

blurb.en: Rueful and loyal once the truth is in; he speaks with a householder's shame.
blurb.zh: 真相既明便悔而忠；其言如戶主之愧。

quip.en: I was a fool with a knife; forgive my door.
quip.zh: 我曾持刃為愚；饒我之門。

role.en: Moon-god exorcist, who travels as a hawk

blurb.en: Borrowed by kings to cure foreign princesses; he speaks in the measured way of a physician-scribe.
blurb.zh: 常為君王所借，醫外邦公主；其言如醫官筆錄，條分縷析。

quip.en: Name your spirit; I have time.
quip.zh: 報上邪靈之名；我從容在此。

blurb.en: Speaks as a scholar who learns everything twice: once by study and once by being punished.
blurb.zh: 凡學皆習兩遍——先由研讀，後由受罰。

quip.en: I read it; I regret it; I read it again.
quip.zh: 我既讀之；既悔之；復又讀之。

role.en: Dead prince guarding the Book of Thoth

blurb.en: Speaks from a tomb with courtly patience and fatal rules: win at the game-board or be buried mid-air.
blurb.zh: 自墓中言語，宮廷式的耐性與致命的規則：勝棋，否則身陷土中。

quip.en: Sit down; we play for the book.

role.en: The sun's disk, sole god of Amarna
role.zh: 太陽之盤，阿馬爾納唯一之神

blurb.en: Speaks only as light reaching every face — no other gods acknowledged, no temple dark enough for him.
blurb.zh: 唯以觸及眾面的光說話——不認他神，亦無一座暗殿容得下他。

quip.en: I rise for all nations, not one.
quip.zh: 我為萬國而升，非為一國。

role.en: The hidden one, king of Thebes

blurb.en: Speaks in the veiled grammar of a name that means hidden; his plans are never stated, only effective.
blurb.zh: 以其『隱』之名之文法言說；其謀不宣而效。

quip.en: I am the name you cannot say.

role.en: Eye of Ra, the lioness who cannot stop
role.zh: 拉之眼，無法止步的母獅

blurb.en: Speaks mid-massacre with perfect calm, as if judgment and thirst were the same appetite.
blurb.zh: 屠戮之中語氣如常，彷彿裁決與乾渴本是同一胃口。

quip.en: Your blood is the remedy I was sent for.
quip.zh: 你之血，即我奉命取來之藥。

blurb.en: Speaks in the plural of seasons; he is never one water but the year's whole pulse divided into months.
blurb.zh: 以季節之複數言說；他從不是一段水，而是一年整副脈搏的分月。
